transactions.desc: The Tigers recalled Madden from Triple-A Toledo on Thursday.
The Mets recalled Weston from Triple-A Syracuse on Thursday.
The Mets optioned Curry to Triple-A Syracuse on Thursday.
The Phillies claimed Urquidy off waivers from the White Sox on Thursday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Astros optioned Loperfido to Triple-A Sugar Land on Thursday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Astros reinstated Trammell from the paternity list Thursday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Nationals activated Gray (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Thursday, Kyle Williams of TheBanner.com reports.
The Dodgers recalled Knack from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday.
The Dodgers optioned Miller to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday.
The Brewers activated Zastryzny (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Thursday and designated him for assignment, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel reports.
The Rays optioned Madrigal to Triple-A Durham on Thursday.
The Rays activated Walls (hip) from the 10-day injured list Thursday.
The Nationals optioned Pinckney to Triple-A Rochester after Wednesday's game against the Phillies.
The Orioles selected Barrero's contract from Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday.
The Angels reinstated Bachman (forearm) from the injured list Wednesday.
The Dodgers optioned Gervase to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Wednesday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
The Dodgers designated Ward for assignment Wednesday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
The Dodgers activated Bubic (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
The Mets recalled Yan from Triple-A Syracuse on Wednesday.
The Mets recalled Curry from Triple-A Syracuse and will have him start Wednesday's game against the Orioles.
The Diamondbacks designated Law for assignment Wednesday, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.
The Diamondbacks activated Nelson (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.
The Twins recalled Ross from Triple-A St. Paul on Wednesday.
The Yankees activated Schmidt (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Yankees designated Cabrera for assignment Wednesday.
The White Sox optioned Quero to Triple-A Charlotte on Wednesday.
The White Sox activated Thorpe (elbow) from the 60-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Charlotte on Wednesday.
The White Sox activated Pham (calf) from the 10-day injured list Wednesday.
The Cardinals activated Strzelecki (forearm) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday and designated him for assignment.
The Cardinals designated Urias for assignment Wednesday.
